props.name: values
props.description: This object encapsulates the data entered into the form fields. Each field key should correspond to the 'name' attribute of the associated form input.

props.name: errors
props.description: This object contains error messages relating to to each field that has invalid data. Field keys should align with the 'name' attribute of each form input element.

props.name: touched
props.description: This object records all fields that have been interacted with. Each field key should align with the 'name' attribute of the form input.

props.name: setFieldValue
props.description: This function allows using custom form fields that are not using the Input or Textarea components

props.name: resetForm
props.description: This function offers the capability to reset the form, providing a clean slate for data entry and submission.
